import json, random, subprocess, sys, time, ipaddress
def ip(x): return str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(x))
rng = random.Random(99)

def clustered(nruns):
    rows = [["::/0", 1]] + [[ip(i) + "/128", i + 1] for i in range(1, nruns - 1)]
    return rows, lambda: ip(rng.randrange(0, nruns))

def tiled(nruns, L):
    step = 1 << (128 - L)
    rows = [[ip(i * step) + "/" + str(L), i + 1] for i in range(nruns)]
    return rows, lambda: ip(rng.randrange(0, nruns) * step + rng.randrange(0, step))

cases = []
rows, addr = clustered(64)
bursts = [{"version": 0, "repeat": 999999, "addresses": [addr() for _ in range(32)]}
          for _ in range(128)]
cases.append({"initial": rows, "transactions": [], "bursts": bursts,
              "cache_pages": 12, "costs": {"hit": 16, "miss": 256, "decode": [16, 16, 16]}})
rows, addr = tiled(63, 6)
bursts = [{"version": 0, "repeat": 999999, "addresses": [addr() for _ in range(32)]}
          for _ in range(128)]
cases.append({"initial": rows, "transactions": [], "bursts": bursts,
              "cache_pages": 12, "costs": {"hit": 1, "miss": 256, "decode": [0, 16, 16]}})
cases.append({"initial": [], "transactions": [[]], "bursts": [],
              "cache_pages": 0, "costs": {"hit": 1, "miss": 1, "decode": [0, 0, 0]}})
data = json.dumps({"cases": cases}).encode()
print('input bytes', len(data))
t = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=data,
                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
print('rc', p.returncode, '%.1fs' % (time.time() - t), 'out', len(p.stdout), p.stderr[:300])
r = json.loads(p.stdout)
print('objectives', [c["objective"] for c in r["cases"]],
      'R', [[len(v["starts"]) for v in c["versions"]] for c in r["cases"]])
EOF
